blocks.task_summary: Write down the speed of the airplane and the car at t=0.
method_path: Substitute t=0 into v_air = 60e^{-0.1t} to get 60
Substitute t=0 into v_car = 5t to get 0

evidence.basis: (i) speed of airplane = 60 (ms−1) A1 (ii) speed of car = 0 (ms−1) A1

blocks.task_summary: Find the time when the airplane and car have the same speed, and that speed.
method_path: Solve for t using GDC to get t ≈ 6.36
Substitute t into either velocity to get speed ≈ 31.8

evidence.basis: (i) recognizing v_air = v_car when speeds are the same (M1) 6.35564... t = 6.36 (s) A1 (ii) 31.7782... speed = 31.8 (ms−1) A1

blocks.task_summary: Find d(t), the distance between the car and the back of the airplane, given d(0)=100.
method_path: Use d(0)=100 to find constant: 100 = (0) - (-600 + C1) + 100? Actually markscheme shows C=700

evidence.basis: recognizing to integrate either velocity function (M1) 60e^{-0.1t} dt, 5t dt correct integration (A1)(A1) -600e^{-0.1t}, (5/2)t^2 (award A1 for each term) recognize to subtract displacements (seen anywhere) (M1) substituting initial condition into their d(t) (M1) C = 700 (or -700) (A1) d(t) = -600e^{-0.1t} - (5/2)t^2 + 700 (accept d(t) = 600e^{-0.1t} + (5/2)t^2 - 700) A1

blocks.task_summary: Find the time it takes for the car to reach the back of the airplane.
